requirement: Each requirement and example definition badge MUST link to its own anchored definition on the current page. The badge MUST have a separate adjacent link containing an accessible right-arrow icon in an integrated segment matching the badge color linking to its evidence detail page. The badge and arrow MUST remain aligned in one non-wrapping row. Definitions MUST NOT be followed by a separate plaintext evidence link. Each detail page MUST link back to the definition's anchored badge and to the index. Reference badges MUST continue to link to the definition. These links MUST resolve when a requirement name contains `.md`, as in `requirements.cli.mdbook`.
rationale: The reviewed tests cover every obligation in `requirements.index.navigation`. I did not read the implementation, and no `{fixme}` acknowledgments apply. - **Badge links to its own anchored definition on the current page.** `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages` asserts `id="habeas-{kind}-rules.{name}" href="#habeas-{kind}-rules.{name}"` for a requirement, an example and a `.md`-containing name. `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` asserts the same for `requirements.core.ready`. `mdbook_preprocessor_renders_definitions_between_stdin_and_stdout` asserts `href="#habeas-req-rules.ready"` through the real binary. - **Separate adjacent link with a right-arrow icon, in a segment matching the badge color, linking to the detail page.** - `definition_badge_and_evidence_icon_share_colors` extracts the badge color from the badge image URL and the icon's `background-color`. It asserts they are equal for both a req and an example. - `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` asserts the `title="View evidence"` and `aria-label` attributes, the white `stroke` on the icon, and the detail href. - `definition_evidence_link_targets_are_escaped` checks the icon's `href` and `aria-label`. - The binary test asserts each badge row contains an ``, a `habeas-detail-icon` link, and exactly two `` elements. That confirms two separate links. - The tests do not check that the icon's shape is an arrow, only its class, stroke and color. I do not treat that as a gap: the other icon properties are asserted, and the arrow shape is not an independent behavior a test could vary. - **One non-wrapping row.** `definition_badge_stylesheet_keeps_the_arrow_in_one_row` checks the stylesheet declarations: `inline-flex`, `align-items`, `flex-wrap: nowrap`, `white-space: nowrap`, `flex-shrink: 0` on the links, and the icon sizing and centering. - **No separate plaintext evidence link.** `!content.contains("See evidence")` is asserted in `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages` and `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons`. - **Detail pages link back to the anchored definition and to the index.** - `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` asserts `[View definition](../../requirements/core.html#habeas-req-requirements.core.ready)` and `[Requirements index](../requirements-index.html) · [View definition]`. - `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages` asserts the index link on every detail page. It asserts the definition link for the `.md` name and for a nested child chapter. - `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` asserts the definition link for an example. - **Reference badges still link to the definition.** `references_in_nested_chapters_link_to_the_requirement_definition` covers the `impl`, `cite` and `test` badges in a nested chapter. Each is asserted to have `href="../requirements.html#habeas-req-requirements.ready"`. - **Names containing `.md`.** - `links_preserve_requirement_names_containing_md` unit-tests `chapter_href` for both the detail link and the definition anchor, expecting `%2Emd` escaping. - `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages` asserts the escaped detail href, the escaped definition `id`/`href` and the escaped back-link for `rules.cli.mdbook`. - `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` asserts the same for an example named `cli.mdbook`. Requirement violations these tests would catch include a missing or wrong anchor, an icon color that differs from the badge, a wrapping layout, a leftover plaintext link, missing back-links, unescaped `.md` names, and broken reference-badge links.
